data.content_ref: inline:The isolated artifact SRC_001 depends on the neighbourhood's shared 189-digit sub-budget for pages 1–99 (derived identically in SRC_002, SRC_003, SRC_004, SRC_005, SRC_006) to anchor its remainder calculation; this dependence is refuted if SRC_001 computes the single-digit and two-digit digit consumption differently (e.g., 10 and 190 digits) while still arriving at 300 pages, which would sever the shared-substrate link.
